tasks.note: Criterion 15's clause 'were each seen failing first' is unmet in letter and cannot be satisfied retroactively; tests were written after the components. Purpose discharged by a durable discrimination matrix (13 injected defects, 9 properties, a no-op control arm) verified by the reviewer. Standing decision for Gate 3.

escalations.question: Approve the four contract changes: ipc.ts reserved namespaces become non-optional BeachcomberApi/HelmApi (+6 invoke channels, +1 push), WorkspaceLayoutProps gains optional panelBar/panel, TOKENS gains seven style and two layout tokens, and preload/api.ts follows mechanically.

options.rationale: ipc.ts itself names this session's change as requiring escalation, and the theme change is the backlog item that predicted this exact moment. All three are additive: no existing slot, token or channel is renamed or removed, so no sub-session 2 component is touched.

options.summary: Approve, but keep the namespaces optional (beachcomber?: BeachcomberApi).
options.rationale: Avoids breaking every constructor of OrcastrateApi at once. Costs the guarantee: an optional member lets a renderer forget to check and lets a stub silently omit it, which is the ?: never softness this session exists to remove.

options.summary: Approve the IPC and theme changes; drop the layout-slot amendment and surface panels another way.
options.rationale: Leaves renderer-view.ts untouched, at the cost of an overlay or route mechanism that the layout does not model and that no existing test id covers.

escalations.answer: Approved all four contract changes as drafted: non-optional namespaces, the optional panelBar/panel slots, the nine token additions, and the mechanical preload follow-on.

escalations.question: Beachcomber's delete-blocking breadth: design section 6 says block a directory backing a currently OPEN Pod, but no liveness predicate exists. Block every known Pod's directory instead?

options.summary: Block every known Pod's directory; say so in the refusal.
options.rationale: Refuses a strict superset of what the design refuses, so it cannot delete live state. Cost: you cannot trash the projects entry for a Pod you still have without deleting the Pod first, and the refusal message names the Pod that blocked it.

options.summary: Add a liveness predicate to PodManagerApi and block exactly what the design says.
options.rationale: Matches the design literally, at the cost of widening a contract in a module this session otherwise never touches, and adding a task in an area with no other work in it.
Cheapest, and wrong in the unsafe direction: status 'idle' covers both open-and-quiet and closed, so this would permit deleting the state of a Pod that is open.

escalations.answer: Block every known Pod directory, with the refusal naming the Pod that blocked it.

escalations.question: crossSessionInbound: only 'accept' and 'refuse' were observed in CLI 2.1.235; the design names three values including 'hold'. Offer 'hold'?

options.summary: Offer all three; 'hold' validates as a warning carrying a verbatim caveat.
options.rationale: Refusing a value the design names would make Helm less capable than a text editor for a file the user can already edit by hand. The caveat states plainly that 'hold' was not confirmed against 2.1.235.

options.summary: Offer only 'accept' and 'refuse' until 'hold' is confirmed.
options.rationale: Helm never writes a value it cannot show is accepted. Cost: a user who wants 'hold' must hand-edit the file, and Helm silently drops a documented option.

escalations.answer: Offer all three values; 'hold' validates as a warning and carries the verbatim unconfirmed caveat.

escalations.question: T1 meets 16 of 17 criteria; criterion 12 ('npm run typecheck and npm test are green') cannot be met from inside T1's ownership. Widening IpcHandlerDeps breaks its one caller, src/main/index.ts, which T8 owns; the 9 test failures are completeness sweeps over INVOKE_CHANNELS in T5's and T10's files. Amending the frozen manifest requires approval.

options.summary: Amend the manifest: accept the red window, criteria 12/13 become T8's to satisfy, and T8 wires src/main/index.ts as its first item.
options.rationale: The three-line change is precisely T8's stated job, and handlers.ts:71-77 already documents T8 as the only place the real implementations are constructed. No throwaway code, no ownership conflict.

options.summary: Amend T1's owns to add src/main/index.ts and have T1 wire a minimal deps pair.
options.rationale: Closes the typecheck window one task earlier, but T1 would construct services T2/T3 have not written yet, putting a throwaway stub in production main and opening a write conflict with T8 against the same file.

options.summary: Change nothing structural; record criteria 12/13 as knowingly deferred to the session merge gate.
options.rationale: Cheapest, and defensible because the branch is not merged mid-session, but it leaves the per-task green invariant unstated for every later task that inherits the same red.

escalations.answer: Amend the manifest: T1's criterion 12 is rescoped to its own ownership (its suites green, typecheck:web green, nothing weakened, every remaining failure named with its owning task), criterion 13's typecheck-green clause is struck, and the whole-repo typecheck-green requirement moves to T8 as its first item. T1 is accepted at 16/17 and commits.

escalations.question: The frozen contracts/renderer-panels.ts does not typecheck: BeachcomberView and HelmView both redeclare error as 'string | null' while Loadable<T>.error is 'IpcError | null' (renderer-state.ts:82-87). T4's criterion 1 requires the file land byte-faithful AND typecheck, which are mutually exclusive as frozen. Changing a frozen contract requires approval. Blocks T5, T6 and T7.

options.summary: Rename the panel field to actionError: string | null on both views, keeping the inherited error: IpcError | null for the list load.
options.rationale: The two fields genuinely mean different things: Loadable.error is documented non-null iff phase === 'error', while the panel field holds the message from the last failed action, which is set by a failed trash or save while phase is 'ready'. Renaming keeps both invariants true and is the only option that does not weaken Loadable. Costs T5/T6/T7 one field name.

options.summary: Retype both panel fields to IpcError | null; T6/T7 render error.message.
options.rationale: Smallest diff and matches every existing view - PodListView extends Loadable<PodTabVm[]> and carries IpcError. But it leaves the phase invariant violated: a failed trash would set error while phase is ready, so any consumer trusting the Loadable docblock is wrong.

options.summary: Drop extends Loadable<...> and spell phase/value/error out on both panel views.
options.rationale: Preserves the frozen field types exactly so T5 implementation is unchanged, but forks the shape every other view shares and defeats the reason Loadable exists.

escalations.answer: Rename the panel field to actionError on both BeachcomberView and HelmView, keeping the inherited error: IpcError | null for the list load. Contract amended in place with the reasoning recorded at both sites.
